view.name: Data Connections history
view.description: Landing page listing the analyst's dataset history as cards grouped by recency, with a search box and a Create DataSource button.

regions.label: Left nav: RATH logo, Data Connections/DataSource, collapsible 'Exploratory Data Analysis' group, Collection/Dashboard/Causal, Insiders(α), and bottom utilities (Support, Appearance, Language, Collapse navigation, Preferences)
'Create DataSource' black primary button and a full-width search input
Recently opened datasources grouped by date bucket (Today, Last week, Last month, Last 3 months, Last half a year, Last year), each a 3-column grid of file cards

evidence.note: Persistent left sidebar with fixed destinations, collapsible group, and collapse/toggle sidebar controls
Grid of datasource cards (name, type/size, last opened); clicking a card (verified live) replaces the main area with the DataSource view (table, stats, distributions)
Outlined card with 1px #e2e0df border, light shadow, 4px radius; file-type line icon, bold name, 'csv - 580KB', 'Last opened' timestamp

patterns.rationale: Collection of data files with kind/size/dates grouped by date (Finder-like recents), but there is no folder hierarchy, path or file operations; could equally be read only as a recents overview.

evidence.note: Files (csv/xlsx/json/db tables) grouped by recency buckets with size and last-opened date
Full-width outlined input with leading search icon, no label or placeholder

patterns.rationale: The search box above the datasource list presumably narrows the list by name, but typing could not be tested live.

evidence.note: Search input directly above the collection
Only a collapsible nav group inside the sidebar, part of the app shell
List is a recents list, not results of a query

structure.layout: app shell: fixed left sidebar nav (256px) + main content with a toolbar (primary button + full-width search field) and a vertically stacked list of date-grouped sections, each a 3-column grid of datasource cards

aesthetics.typography: System UI stack (-apple-system; rendered as Ubuntu in capture) throughout: 16px regular for group headings, 14px semibold card titles and nav items, 12px for metadata, timestamps and nav section labels
aesthetics.typeScale: Compressed scale 12/14/16px; hierarchy via weight (600 titles, 500 button/active nav, 400 body) rather than size; no large display type

notes: Near-monochrome warm-grey UI; the only colour is the orange bird logo. Single black primary button ('Create DataSource'). Cards are uniform 380x104 outlined tiles with 1px #e2e0df border, tiny shadow, 4px radius, off-white fill; file-type line icon (table for csv, sheet for xlsx, braces for json, plain doc for demos/DB). Grouping headers are plain 16px text with date ranges in parentheses. Sidebar #fafafa with a 1px right edge and a hidden 'Toggle Sidebar' hit strip; utilities pinned to the bottom. Clicking a card switches to the DataSource view (table with per-column distribution charts and summary stats).
